component.name: iPod Converter
component.summary: Convert music and videos for classic iPods

description.p: Converts videos and music so they play on iPod 5G/5.5G, iPod classic, iPod nano and iPod touch: the right resolution and H.264 profile for each model (Standard or Maximum quality), AAC audio without clipping, tags and covers kept. Finds duplicate videos and moves extra copies to the Trash.
Converted files go to an output folder; copy them to the iPod with Rhythmbox, gtkpod or Strawberry.
